slots.sample: A heavy machine foundation is not simply a bigger block of concrete. It is a vibrating system with its own natural frequency, and the designer’s job is to keep that frequency well away from the equipment’s operating range.
slots.label: Four common mistakes in heavy machine foundation design
slots.current: A heavy machine foundation is not simply a bigger block of concrete. It is a vibrating system with its own natural frequency, and the designer’s job is to keep that frequency well away from the equipment’s operating range.

slots.sample: 1. Taking dynamic loads from the catalogue instead of measuring them
slots.label: Four common mistakes in heavy machine foundation design

slots.sample: Manufacturer figures are nominal values under ideal conditions. On presses and crushers, real amplitudes can run 20–40% higher once the tooling has worn.

slots.current: Manufacturer figures are nominal values under ideal conditions. On presses and crushers, real amplitudes can run 20–40% higher once the tooling has worn.

slots.sample: Strengthening a badly designed foundation typically costs four times what a vibration survey would have cost before the pour.
slots.label: Four common mistakes in heavy machine foundation design
slots.current: Strengthening a badly designed foundation typically costs four times what a vibration survey would have cost before the pour.

slots.sample: 2. Ignoring frost penetration and seasonal soil movement

slots.sample: In central Russia the design frost depth reaches 1.6 m and the groundwater table moves a metre or more between spring and autumn. That changes the subgrade modulus and pulls the foundation’s natural frequency towards resonance.
